build_sam2_package: build the SAM-2 package with pip install -e . to install segment anything model 2
build_sam2_cuda_extension: build the SAM-2 CUDA extension by running setup.py with SAM2_BUILD_CUDA=1 enabled
install_sam2_with_extras: install SAM-2 with extra dependencies like notebooks or dev using pip install -e .[dev]
get_extensions: get the CUDA extension modules for the SAM-2 connected components implementation
review_BuildExtensionIgnoreErrors: review the BuildExtensionIgnoreErrors class that gracefully handles CUDA build failures during setup
